conclusion.label: endorses

report:
**Conclusion:**  
Scientific evidence supports the claim that consuming more olive oil reduces stroke risk, contradicting the view that the claim is false.

**Summary of Evidence:**
1. **Randomized Controlled Trials:** The landmark PREDIMED trial demonstrated that participants at high cardiovascular risk following a Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra-virgin olive oil had a lower incidence of major cardiovascular events, including stroke, compared to those assigned to a reduced-fat diet (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29897866/).
2. **Meta-Analyses:** Meta-analytic research analyzing thousands of participants indicates that daily intake of olive oil (roughly two tablespoons per day) is associated with an estimated 26% lower risk of stroke (https://www.myolivea.com/blogs/research/olive-oil-stroke-cardiovascular-meta-analysis-2014).
3. **Observational Cohort Studies:** Comprehensive meta-analyses evaluating case-control and prospective cohort studies show a consistent inverse association between higher olive oil consumption and lower stroke risk, cardiovascular events, and overall mortality (https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/british-journal-of-nutrition/article/olive-oil-consumption-and-risk-of-chd-andor-stroke-a-metaanalysis-of-casecontrol-cohort-and-intervention-studies/79A90337470271D8A8CE2FDC77BD869E; https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0261561421005033).

While observational studies must control for potential lifestyle confounders, the convergence of evidence from large meta-analyses and clinical intervention trials confirms that olive oil consumption offers protective cardiovascular benefits against stroke.

**Sources Cited:**
* https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29897866/
* https://www.myolivea.com/blogs/research/olive-oil-stroke-cardiovascular-meta-analysis-2014
* https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/british-journal-of-nutrition/article/olive-oil-consumption-and-risk-of-chd-andor-stroke-a-metaanalysis-of-casecontrol-cohort-and-intervention-studies/79A90337470271D8A8CE2FDC77BD869E
* https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0261561421005033
